title: Reapply date-label styling after bar axis limits change
answers: Why do some bar-chart date labels ignore rotation or font size?
Can a narrow xlim leave minor date ticks without styling?
Why does BarPlot apply axis properties again after set_xlim?
body:
Invariant: Dynamic bar date axes must reapply rot and fontsize after set_xlim in pandas/plotting/_matplotlib/core.py:BarPlot._post_plot_logic.
Mechanism: Changing limits can create minor ticks that _post_plot_logic_common never saw, including when a narrow user xlim initially left the view without them.
Consequence: Removing the later _apply_axis_properties call can leave newly created minor date labels without the requested rotation or font size, even when locators were installed earlier.
Verification: pandas/tests/plotting/test_datetimelike.py:TestTSPlot.test_bar_plot_date_axis_rot_applies_to_minor_ticks draws the canvas and checks visible, nonempty major and minor labels with both default and narrow limits.
applies: Rotation and font-size handling for dynamic date axes in Matplotlib bar plots when axis limits can create additional ticks.
